itens.trecho: Verdadeiramente original. Eu achava que já tinha visto quase tudo o que podia ver em relação ao Homem-Aranha, porque é uma daquelas personagens que insiste em voltar ao cinema com alguma regularidade.

Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (2018) is no ordinary Spider-Man movie, it contains multiple characters with the same powers in multiple dimensions. This is also not an ordinary animated movie. It has animated style we have never seen before. There were 177 animators and it took 1 week to animate 1 second and 1 year to nail down 10 seconds.

It's true I liked it less than perhaps the vast majority of Spider-Verse's audience, but this was still great, the animation enamouring, and the depth of its story and reference totally engaging. Not to me the best Spider-Man movie as many have said, (that honour still goes to Homecoming) but a blast all the same. Final rating:★★★½ - I really liked it.
